title: Using tessl init
description:
Ready to kickstart your first project with Tessl? 🚀

Once you have the Tessl CLI installed, the next step is to initialize your project. This quick tutorial walks you through using the tessl init command.

We'll show you how to create a new project directory and run the command to generate all the required files, getting you up and running with Tessl in under 30 seconds. With your project initialized, you're ready for the next step: setting up your agent.
